def legendre_symbol(a, p):
    if a % p == 0:
        return 0
    return 1 if pow(a, (p-1)//2, p) == 1 else -1

n = 23
b = [1] + [legendre_symbol(i, n) for i in range(1, n)]

x = b
y = b

# Check sums
print("Sum x:", sum(x))
print("Sum y:", sum(y))

# Check cross-correlation for k=1..11
def autocorr(seq, k):
    n = len(seq)
    return sum(seq[i] * seq[(i+k) % n] for i in range(n))

print("\nC(k) = A_x(k) + A_y(k):")
for k in range(1, 12):
    ck = autocorr(x, k) + autocorr(y, k)
    print(f"k={k}: C(k)={ck}")

# Full solution
solution = x + y
print("\nSolution (x ++ y):", solution)
